t: A desktop app that reads text, web pages, PDFs, and ebooks aloud offline.
steps: Find the Out Loud website and read the download notes.
Ask IT to approve the install and the school use terms.
Download the installer for Mac, Windows, or Linux.
Stay online while the app downloads a voice model once.
Go offline and test a short text.
Open a PDF and try several voices.
Try the Chrome extension on a Chromebook and report the result to IT.
